dedupe_keys.name: low and mid rise thin lightly reinforced concrete wall buildings parameters and performance metrics

description: Ricardo Bonett, Orlando Arroyo and Julián Carrillo publish parameters and seismic performance measures for 52 thin lightly reinforced concrete-wall building archetypes representative of Colombian housing. The October 2025 Excel workbook is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The metadata describe stiffness and wall indices, aspect ratio, wall thickness, reinforcement ratios, fragility curves and collapse probabilities at the Maximum Considered Earthquake. The study used OpenSeesPy and hazard-consistent ground motions, but the visible inventory contains one workbook, so executable numerical models are not claimed as available. The table can calibrate or compare building fragility assumptions in regional risk simulations. Archetype representativeness, column units and uncertainty remain unverified without inspecting the workbook. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these 52 cases. No data or model was downloaded or run.
